name: glute ham sit up
description: A sit-up on a glute ham bench. The extra range of motion works the abs and hip flexors hard.
instructions: Set your feet under the pads of a glute ham bench, hips on the support.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back to a comfortable depth.
Brace your abs and curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep your lower back from over-arching at the bottom.
